instruction: Install the extension from the helloExtension directory located on Desktop into Chrome.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: This variation verifies both the extension name and path are correctly registered. Checks that an extension with name 'Hello Extensions' and path '/home/user/Desktop/helloExtension' exists in Chrome preferences.
